title: How a shared state is described determines whether AI agents synchronize: data and code
description:
Research data and code by Takahiro Ezaki, Naoto Imura and Katsuhiro Nishinari.

This release provides recorded acquisitions, protocols, offline analyses, figure-generation code and reference figure assets. The earlier analyses include 507,112 valid responses, including 25,920 responses in the Claude controlled-field follow-up.

Version 2.0.0 adds later acquisitions and offline analyses: frozen response-model forecasts of new populations, reflection interventions, fixed-state tests and a resource-allocation task, with their raw journals, frozen forecasts, derived tables and figure code. Response counts of these acquisitions are listed per acquisition set in the archive.
